parsed.note_claim: NATO provides aid to Ukraine but is not directly engaged in combat with Russia and has no troops deployed there.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Enforcing a no-fly zone or deploying combat troops to Ukraine would bring NATO forces into direct conflict with Russia. This would significantly escalate the war and lead to more human suffering and destruction for all countries involved.
